dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature following a parabolic spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior slope, approximately 70 degrees relative to the dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height exceeds base width by approximately 20%.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex melon with a uniform radius arc extending from the blowhole area to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum extension with visible blunt termination.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse transition between the melon convexity and the rostrum dorsal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Overall high-contrast cyan-toned chromatic filter or luminescent effect applied to the entire subject.
